chapter.verse: Theophilus aw, Jesu' nasep leh a thuhilh teng khempeuh laibu a masa sungah kong pulak khinzo a,
tuate pen Jesu in ama' tenkhiatsa sawltakte' tungah Kha Siangtho tungtawnin thupiakna a neih khit, a kilaktoh ni ciangdong a sep a hilh thute ahi hi.
Amah a sih khitin tua mite' kiangah lahcianna tampi tawh a hingin kilang a, amaute' kiangah ni sawmli sung kilaakin Pasian' kumpigam thu genkhia hi.
Tua bangin tua mite tawh a om laitak Jesu in amaute Jerusalem a nusiat loh nadingun thupia a, “Kei' tungpan na zaksa uh ahi, Pa' hong kamciam na ngak un.
A hang pen John in tui tawh baptize a, ahi zongin tu zawh ni tampi ma-in Kha Siangtho tawh note hong kibaptize ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua hangin amaute kikaikhawmin Jesu' kiangah, “Topa aw, tu tungin Israel mite' ading kumpigam na bawlhoihkik ta ding hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in, “Pa in ama' uktheihna thu tawh a sehsa hunte note' theih ding thu hilo hi.
Ahi zongin note' tungah Kha Siangtho hong tun ciangin vangliatna na ngah ding uh a, Jerusalem khua, Judea gam bup, Samaria gam bup leh leimong dong ah keima' teci na hiding uh hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu teng a gen khit, amau' et laitak mahin Jesu kilato a, meii in amaute' muhna pan paipihto hi.
Amaute Jesu' paina vantung lam a etet laitakun, en un, amaute' gei-ah puantual paak silh mi nih hong ding uh a,
“Galilee mite aw, bang hangin vantung lam enen na hi uh hiam? Note' kiangpan vantung ah a kilato hih Jesu, vantung a paitoh na muh dan bangun amah hong paikik ding hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute Jerusalem gei, Sabbath nikhat lam a gamlatna Olive a kici mual panin Jerusalem ah kilehkik uh hi.

Khuasung a tun uh ciangin Peter leh John, James leh Andrew, Philip leh Thomas, Bartholomew leh Matthew, Alphaeus' tapa James leh Gamkhualpa Simon, leh James' tapa Judas, amau teng a taamna mun inndei tungnung ah kahto uh hi.
Tu-a teng in numeite, Jesu' nu Mary, leh Jesu' sanggamte tawh a vekun lungsim kikhatin thungetna neikhawm den uh hi.
Tua hun sungin sanggamte (a vekpi-un mimal zakhat sawmnih kiim a pha kikhopna) laizang ah Peter dingto a,
“Sanggamte aw, Jesu a mante' kiangah lamhilh a sem Judas tawh kisai thu, Kha Siangtho in David' kam zangin a genkholhna Pasian' Laibu a tangtun kul ahi hi.
Amah pen ei' pawlmi-a kisim hi a, hih seppina sungah zong tanh ngah hi,” ci hi.
(Tu-in hih mipa in ama' siattatna pana a ngah thaman tawh leitang mun khat lei a, tua mun ah muktu-in a gilpi kitam ahih manin a sungkua teng lawtkhia hi.
Jerusalem khuamite khempeuh in hih thupiang theikha uh ahih manin tua lo pen amau' pau-in Akeldama ci uh a, a khiatna Sisan Lo cihna ahi hi.)
A hang pen Phatna Late sungah hih bangin kigelh hi: “‘Ama' nasepna phual kilawi henla, a sungah kuamah teeng kei ta hen,’ cih leh, “‘Ama' panmun midang khat in luah ta hen.’
Tua hi a, eite lakah Topa Jesu sungtum pusuakin hong om hun sung khempeuh ei tawh hong kikhawl,

John ii baptize huna kipan ei' kiangpan amah a kilaktoh hun ciangdong ei tawh hong omhawm hih mite lakpan khat peuhmah Jesu' thawhkikna thu ei tawh teci a pangkhawm khat hong suah kul ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Barsabbas a kici, Justus zong a kici veve ahi Joseph, leh Matthias, hih mi nih tengkhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in thungen uh a, “Mi khempeuh' lungsim a thei Topa, nangmah in hihte nih lakah nangma' tenkhiat pen hong lak in.
Hih seppina leh sawltak za pan pialkhia-in ama' neihtuam mun a zuan Judas' mun a laih ding ahi hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin suangtang ai san uh a, Matthias in ngah ahih manin amah pen sawltak sawmlekhatte tawh kisimkhawm hi.
